provenance.navigation: Opened the original app and clicked Launch Studio. Did not activate Try Demo Mode, Voice, microphone recording, camera, playback, production prompts, or message submission.
notes: Unmodified source UI served locally by Vite with a credential-free environment and checkout-local HOME. Dependency install scripts were disabled; no build, lint or tests were run.

The welcome message, example project title, lyrics, instrument defaults, and Raw Idea label are prepopulated by the original source, not generated or recorded during capture. No musical analysis is present and no user conversation was fabricated.
The studio's Voice action can enter the author's sandbox-backed connection flow. That action was deliberately not invoked or used to claim a genuine Agora call.

An initial domain-restricted browser could not render the app: its restrictions disable RTCPeerConnection, which conflicts with the imported RTC SDK. A separate clean named session without that restriction rendered the unmodified studio. No private browser profile or credential state was used.

Fonts loaded before capture. The source's visual effects and labels were retained. Visually reviewed; lossless WebP conversion without resizing or cropping. Owner approval and catalog rendering remain pending.
The earlier landing image is preserved as public/recipes/muse-ai.webp; its provenance remains in captures-2026-10-27.json.
